research.title: Price Atlas
research.coverage: Monthly product prices · BC and Nova Scotia are provincial averages
research.instruction: Compare the same product, package and published month. These are regional transaction averages, not a quote from a Vancouver or Halifax shop.

research.title: Pantry Prices
research.coverage: Grocery baskets · provincial scanner prices from 2017 where available
research.instruction: Choose the same price series, month and package quantities for both provinces. Historical urban and national tables have different coverage and must remain separate.

research.title: Housing Pulse
research.coverage: Housing markets · Vancouver and Halifax census metropolitan areas where published
research.instruction: Compare the same dwelling size and quarter. Asking rents and paid rents describe different groups of homes; use an actual listing or lease for your own housing entry.

research.title: Wage Window
research.coverage: Job Bank wages · occupation and economic region, including Halifax and Lower Mainland
research.instruction: Select the exact NOC and economic region, then check the wage reference period and annual/hourly unit. A release year is not necessarily the measurement year; enter your actual offer above.

research.title: Fuel Window
research.coverage: Regulated fuel limits · Nova Scotia and PEI; no BC pump-price coverage
research.instruction: Choose the correct Nova Scotia pricing zone and effective date. Limits are not live station quotes. For Vancouver, enter your observed local price and trip or commuting costs.

research_checklist: I have dated housing quotes for comparable homes, including fees and utilities.
I have compared grocery packages using the same source, geography level and month.
I have confirmed each job offer’s paid hours, weeks, benefits and likely payroll deductions.
I have priced transport, insurance, child care and utilities for the actual address.
I have separated final moving expenses from refundable deposits and set aside immediate cash needs.
